answer: Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 206 aliases means carrying 295 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. The ocean escrow is released only against a prism receipt, and the trellis audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 5 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 20 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
